subject: chinese
source: 义务教育语文课程标准（2022年版）

knowledge_points.label: literacy_1600

knowledge_points.label: writing_800

knowledge_points.label: punctuation

knowledge_points.label: recitation

knowledge_points.description: 课外阅读总量不少于5万字

knowledge_points.label: reading_inference
